settings.question: Can I swap a blend in the Complete Bundle?
settings.answer: Not currently. The Complete Bundle is fixed at all six blends, that's how we keep the price down and the order simple. If there's a specific blend you don't want, you can buy the other five individually, or grab a 3-Pack of your favorite from the stock-up section above.

settings.question: What if I already have one of the blends?
settings.answer: The Complete Bundle is still the best per-jar value on the site, and it ships free. Most folks keep the extra jar as a backup or give the duplicate to a friend, that's how a lot of repeat bundle orders start. If you'd rather not double up, grab a 3-Pack of your favorite from the stock-up section above instead.

settings.question: How long does a bundle last?
settings.answer: The six jars carry 856 servings on their labels in total. That is 142 for each 5 oz jar, 168 for Daily Blend, and 120 for Bella Blend. How fast it goes depends on how often you cook.

settings.question: What's the difference between the Complete Bundle and building my own?
settings.answer: The Complete Bundle is a curated set, one of each of our six blends, added in one click ($64.99, save $12.95). Build Your Own (above) lets you pick any combination and the price scales as you add: 3 jars for $33.99, 4 for $45.96, 5 for $57.95, or 6 for $64.99, doubles of your favorites welcome. Both ship free. Pick the Complete Bundle for instant variety, or build your own if you already know what you like.

settings.question: Can I mix and match different blends?
settings.answer: Yes, that's exactly what Build Your Own (above) is for. Add any blends you like and the deal grows with your cart: 3 jars $33.99, 4 jars $45.96, 5 jars $57.95, 6 jars $64.99. Want two Daily Blends and one Taco Blast? Go for it, every jar counts toward the bundle price.

settings.question: Can I order both the Complete Bundle and a custom mix?
settings.answer: Yes. Some customers do exactly that, the Complete Bundle for variety, plus a few extra jars of their go-to blend from Build Your Own. Both ship free.

settings.question: Is the bundle giftable?
settings.answer: Absolutely. Most of our bundle sales around the holidays are gifts. The Complete Bundle ships in one box and feels gift-ready as-is.

settings.question: What if I don't like one of the blends?
settings.answer: Every SpiceX order comes with a 30-day money back guarantee. If you are not happy with it, email us within 30 days.
